exposure: Analysis using cases and controls from Alberta, Canada, only
outcome: Discriminative accuracy of the prediction model for perinatal arterial ischemic stroke (PAIS)
cohort: 2571 term neonates (527 cases and 2044 controls) from multiple registries
finding: A prediction model using 9 clinical factors demonstrated good discrimination in predicting the risk of PAIS in term neonates.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean delivery was a significant predictor of PAIS in the model.
